name: @loom/planner-learning
description: The learning lifecycle for a loom-ui planner, end to end: viewers vote on the surface they were SHOWN (authenticated viewer, exposure required, one bounded vote each) -> a VoteLedger -> one late reward on the planner's recorded decision; a candidate layout policy is registered, run in SHADOW (scored, never served), canaried on a stable slice, judged off-policy by the promotion gate and then promoted, or ROLLED BACK when the world drifted under it. Replay serves the recorded choice. Headless, offline, deterministic.
